projects.title: AI Avatar Style Editing
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted avatar video for a Codecure AI hiring campaign, edited to feel like a real corporate shoot. Animated captions, smooth zoom-ins, clean motion graphics and light-leak transitions turn a simple talking avatar into an engaging, scroll-stopping ad.

projects.title: AI Model Campaign
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted fashion campaign featuring a hyper-realistic model in an embroidered cream kurta. Slow close-ups, low-angle full-body shots and smooth camera moves give it the feel of a real luxury shoot, captured in a warm, moody library set.

projects.title: SKIN CARE AD SHOT
projects.description: A 100% AI-crafted skincare commercial for MOOD CARE Hydra Glow Gel Cream, built to look like a real beauty campaign. Every angle, close-up and camera move feels like it was shot on a professional set, right down to the dewy final glow.
